newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends down against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends down against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed down at 8.2925 on Tuesday from Monday's 8.2920 against the U.S. dollar due to selling at around the 8.2920 level, traders said.
The weighted average price on Monday was 8.2923.

The yuan opened lower at an intraday low of 8.2927 and rose slightly to move in a narrow range between the intraday high of 8.2921 and 8.2925 for most of the session. Trading was dull with most business done at 8.2923, traders said.
One dealer said the yuan's upward trend on Monday was firmly checked on Tuesday due to heavy selling when the yuan approached the 8.2920 resistance level.
"Active selling was seen at about 8.2920 on Tuesday, which is regarded as the main resistance in the short term," he said. "A lacking of fresh market-moving stimuli made trading dull."
Dealers said they expected the yuan to move around 8.2920 on Wednesday.
The yuan closed slightly higher at 7.3301 from 7.3502 against 100 Japanese yen and slightly down at 1.0705 from 1.0703 against the Hong Kong dollar.
